scheme_name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must have a space or shed for keeping animals
A self‑declaration for unemployment and commitment to abide by scheme conditions must be submitted
benefits_summary: Provides subsidies for establishing dairy, piggery, and sheep/goat units (50%–90% of livestock cost) with maximum assistance up to ₹88,200, administered as a loan.
